interpretations.signingFixtureIndependence: Known-proof omission and duplicate-input controls use population0, abort uses population1, and signable/sign uses population2. A failed known-proof call may reserve population0 without suppressing the independent signing case. The post-abort query must show population1 spendable and population2 absent after signing; no claim about population0 release is inferred.
interpretations.outputTransactionLabels: Both combined outputs-metadata and outputs-only-includeLabels requests return ordinary transaction-associated labels. Compare their unique string labels exactly against independently queried actions-includes for the same populated transaction, after validating and removing only its exact BRC153 response-only reference annotation. Require every caller-supplied label on both sides; preserve all administration and other ordinary labels. BRC153 annotation must be unique and equal lowercasehex(canonicalBase64Decode(reference)) from the separate identity-scoped controlled storage action-reference ledger, which the parent binds again after shutdown. Output labels may not contain reserved reference annotations. This does not infer a stored reference from txid or accept arbitrary prefix stripping. Scripts, tags, custom instructions and mined BEEF bindings stay unchanged.
interpretations.queryTotals: The existing query.actions-pagination beyond-end expectation of totalActions=11 is an explicit prospective lab interpretation: totalActions counts the matching query before pagination.
